description: Returns recent news headlines for one player, newest first, each tagged by impact (injury, role, transaction or general). Use it for "any news on X?" and injury or role questions about a specific player; for the whole league use get_latest_news. Basic plan and above.

impact.description: Only headlines with this impact tag.
impact.title: Impact

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

name: get_player_news

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

message.description: Present when there is no news.

news.description: Headlines, newest first, each tagged by impact.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

request_scrape.description: Present when there is no news: request_news_scrape queues a fresh pull.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

title: Player news
